svg.title: Document agent: edit any Word, Markdown, EPUB, PDF or text file
svg.desc: Same harness contract as code: the agent proposes, you approve a word-level diff, the harness writes and verifies.
svg.text: Document agent: edit any Word, Markdown, EPUB, PDF or text file
Same harness contract as code: the agent proposes, you approve a word-level diff, the harness writes and verifies.
ZipLite (own ZIP reader/writer, no dependencies) · DocxAdapter · EpubAdapter · MarkdownAdapter · PdfReader. Output: sections (chapters) → blocks with exact source ranges.
Code, tables, links, footnotes, fields and images are PROTECTED blocks the agent can never touch.
ES/EN patterns → proofread · style · shorten · expand · translate · custom (edit) or
Scope = whole document or one chapter. Above 20 model calls the tab asks for
confirmation; hard limit 60. Cloud providers show a PII-redaction notice.
Batches ≤ 5 000 chars (2 200 for small local models) → prompt with numbered
[[id]] paragraphs → the model returns only the changed ones. Unknown ids are
Map-reduce over chapters: summaries, fact sheets for cross-chapter consistency,
developmental notes, outline, Q&A over the most relevant chapters → Markdown
Local model (Ollama / LM Studio: private, free) or cloud behind PrivacyBoundaryProvider (PII and secrets redacted before sending).
Word-level diff per paragraph. Unusually large rewrites, changed numbers or big
length changes are flagged “review” and are NOT pre-selected.
Output is a NEW file by default. Overwrite makes a backup in
.alpaquitay/backups. Word edits are written as tracked changes (Accept / Reject
The written file is re-read: it must parse, keep the same block count, and contain
decisions.jsonl entry · debt +/− · economy (LLM calls vs local) · reports and
exports saved next to the source.
